test_sort_index_basic: test sorting a Series by its index in ascending or descending order
test_sort_index_inplace: test sorting a Series by index in-place with ascending or descending parameter
test_sort_index_level: test sorting a MultiIndex Series by specified level(s) with sort_remaining option
test_sort_index_key: test sorting a Series by index using a custom key function like lambda x: x.str.lower()
test_sort_index_multiindex: test sorting a MultiIndex Series by level name or integer position with ascending list
